sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a young fox standing on all four legs. Draw this exact fox as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, fur texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the orange furry body seen from the side as in image 1, from the cream chest and bib at the front to the rump at the back, with the cream belly underneath, without head, without tail and without any legs: no legs, no shoulders, no thighs, no haunches and no paws drawn on it — its underside one smooth rounded line from the chest to the rump; the top of the neck, normally under the head, rounded.
2. the head: the fox's head with its cream cheeks, rosy cheeks and black nose, facing left as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no eyebrows, no mouth — keep the nose and the rosy cheeks; without ears; its bottom edge, at the neck, rounded.
3. one ear: the big pointed ear on the right of image 1, orange with a dark back and tip and cream fluff inside, with a rounded base.
4. one front leg: the near front leg of image 1 (the one under the chest) drawn whole, from the top of the shoulder down to the paw: the broad rounded orange shoulder and upper leg (the part that joins the chest), the dark brown stocking below and the dark paw; straight, as in image 1; its top is the full, smooth, rounded curve of the shoulder.
5. the same front leg lifted: the shoulder and upper leg as in part 4, but the lower leg bent at the wrist and the dark paw raised, as a fox lifts one front paw; its top the same rounded shoulder.
6. one back leg: the near back leg of image 1 drawn whole, from the top of the haunch down to the paw: the big rounded orange thigh (the whole haunch at the rump, as big as it is in image 1), the bent hock, the dark brown stocking and the dark paw; its top is the full, smooth, rounded curve of the haunch.
7. the tail: the big fluffy orange tail with its cream-white tip, as in image 1, with a rounded base.
8. the same tail curled round: the big fluffy tail bent round in a soft crescent, as when a fox curls its tail round the front of its body to keep warm, its cream-white tip curling up at the end, with a rounded base.
9. the body lying down: the same fox's body lying down on the ground as when it settles for a nap, seen from the side facing left, its legs folded underneath so only the dark front paws peep out in front, without head and without tail; the top of the neck rounded.
10. the head turned right round to look back over its shoulder at its own tail: the same head seen facing right, with both ears, its eyes closed in happy arcs and its mouth open in a playful nibble showing small white teeth; its bottom edge, at the neck, rounded.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a young fox; image 2 shows the same fox cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the fox's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the fox in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the fox's left eye (the bigger eye, on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle and a cream rim.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the same eye squeezed tight shut, as just before a sneeze: a short crinkled zigzag line.
7. the eyebrow as it is in image 1: a thin dark arched line.
8. the same eyebrow sad: tilted up at its inner end.
9. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small closed happy smile, just the dark line.
10. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
11. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
12. the mouth in a small sad frown.
13. the jaws open wide, as in a big yawn or a snap: a tall open mouth with a pink tongue and two rows of small white teeth.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no nose, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.
